comment_regular:
Ensure NiGeometryData normal storage exists and optionally clear it. Allocates one NiPoint3 per vertex, or three per vertex when format & 0xF000 indicates NBT data. Clearing an NBT buffer also zeros binormal/tangent planes.

Verified Prettier Faces audit: allocate 12*vertexCount bytes or 36*vertexCount when format at +0x2C has any 0xF000 bits. clearStorage clears all allocated planes. TriShape/TriStrips UpdateNormals both request clearing but rebuild only first plane; plugin's NBT exclusion preserves tangent/binormal storage. Prototype corrected to NiGeometryData*, bool.
